_readme: Curated metadata and heuristics for models served by the ISIS LLM gateway.
defaults.contextWindow / defaults.maxTokens apply to models the gateway reports but this file does not know.
exclude: case-insensitive regex sources for non-chat ids (embeddings, TTS, image models, ...). Curated ids and ids with a local override are never excluded.
reasoningPatterns: case-insensitive regex sources marking an unknown id as reasoning-capable.
thinkingFormats: compat.thinkingFormat applied to unknown ids by regex, first match wins. Anything unmatched is left unset so pi auto-detects.

models: METADATA ONLY — this file never registers a model. An id appears in pi only when /v1/models reports it; these entries then decorate it. Set reasoning true only when the gateway returns reasoning_content; compat.thinkingFormat is the chat-template dialect used to toggle thinking. contextWindow/maxTokens here are the OFFLINE fallback only — when /v1/models reports max_input_tokens/max_output_tokens those win (still clamped to half the window), so a bumped deployment needs no edit here.
